transcript: I think the green utopia one was closest to what I would want, and it hit on a lot of positive things that I would look for in a future society. What was absent, I feel like, from all of them was establishing a value that this society is accepting of all people, no matter race or sexuality. Because that would be essential to me in a utopian society, is knowing that everyone is able to live and access resources equally.

chunks.text: I think the green utopia one was closest to what I would want, and it hit on a lot of positive things that I would look for in a future society.
What was absent, I feel like, from all of them was establishing a value that this society is accepting of all people, no matter race or sexuality.
Because that would be essential to me in a utopian society, is knowing that everyone is able to live and access resources equally.
